# Plantjes. v1.1.0

**Dependency and toolchain release — 17 November 2026**

Plantjes 1.1.0 keeps the runtime and build stack current. It contains no new application features, no database schema changes, and no changes to the `.plantjes` backup format.

## Dependency upgrades

| Package | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `react` | 18.3.1 | 19.3.1 |
| `react-dom` | 18.3.1 | 19.3.1 |
| `@types/react` | 18.3.12 | 19.3.0 |
| `@types/react-dom` | 18.3.1 | 19.3.0 |
| `vite` | 6.4.5 | 8.3.8 |
| `@vitejs/plugin-react` | 4.7.0 | 6.3.0 |
| `typescript` | 5.6.3 | 7.0.2 |
| `dexie` | 4.0.11 | 4.4.7 |
| `lucide-react` | 1.73.0 | 1.74.0 |

`@testing-library/react` 16.3.3, `jsdom` 31.0.1, and `vitest` 5.1.0 were already current.

React and its type packages were upgraded together, as were Vite 8 and `@vitejs/plugin-react` 6, so their peer requirements stay aligned.

## Compatibility and upgrade notes

- Vite 8 and plugin-react 6 require Node.js `^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0`. The documented Node.js 22 setup and CI environment meet this requirement.
- Existing journals and `.plantjes` backups remain compatible. No migration is required.
- The production build now uses Vite 8.3.8 and TypeScript 7.0.2.
- No application source changes were required for the upgrade.
- Deploy the newly built static assets as usual; there is no user action beyond loading the updated build.

## Validation

- Clean `npm ci`
- `npm audit --audit-level=high` — 0 vulnerabilities
- `npm test` — 139 tests passed
- `npm run build` — production build passed on Vite 8.3.8
- Production CSP still injected; no source maps emitted
- CI passed on the dependency and release pull requests

The production JavaScript bundle grew from about 346.7 kB to 410.7 kB (gzip 106.9 kB to 125.8 kB) as part of the updated runtime and build stack.

For the full application feature list, see the [Plantjes 1.0 release](https://github.com/Minprez-JP/Plantjes/releases/tag/v1.0).
